assumptions: Entry = first NSE trading day on/after the 27th of each month; Exit = first NSE trading day on/after the 4th of the following month (both via Close price).
Trading/holiday calendar derived directly from the fetched index series (days with no quote = weekend/holiday) -- no separate holiday list needed.
Cash return while out of the market assumed 0% (no risk-free rate credited) -- this UNDERSTATES the strategy vs a cash-earning alternative.
Price-return index (no dividends), zero transaction costs/slippage -- real-world execution would be worse.
First cycle = Jan 2017 (per requested window); last row = today; if today falls mid-cycle it is marked OPEN and mark-to-market.
